steps.title: Express Mouse alpha-synuclein
steps.instruction: Inoculate and grow BL21(DE3) + pT7-7 (mouse α-syn) cells to induce protein expression.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate BL21(DE3) + pT7-7 (mouse α-syn) into LB + ampicillin (100 µg/mL).
Grow at 37°C with shaking until OD₆₀₀ = 0.5–0.6.
Induce expression with IPTG to a final concentration of 1 mM.
Continue incubation at 37°C for 4 h.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the cell pellet via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells (e.g., 5,000 × g, 10 min, 4°C).
Proceed immediately to lysis or freeze pellets at −80°C.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Break open cells using lysis buffer and mechanical force.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet in lysis buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA, 0.25 mg/mL lysozyme) using ~5–10 mL buffer per g wet cell pellet.
Incubate briefly on ice (5–15 min) for lysozyme action.
Lyse cells using a French press (≥1000 psi) or equivalent, keeping lysate cold.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Remove nucleic acids and cellular debris from the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Add streptomycin sulfate to 0.1% (w/v) to precipitate nucleic acids; mix and incubate for a few minutes.
Centrifuge at 15,000 × g for 20–30 min at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Ammonium Sulfate Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform sequential precipitation at 4°C to enrich α-syn.

substeps.instruction: Precipitate to 30% saturation and remove the pellet (optional).
Increase saturation to 50% and collect the pellet containing α-syn (adjust volumes/salt per standard tables).

steps.title: Denature Contaminants
steps.instruction: Use heat and centrifugation to remove contaminating proteins.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the 50% pellet in 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4.
Heat the sample at 95°C for 15 min, then cool on ice.
Centrifuge at 13,500 × g for 20 min at 4°C and retain the supernatant.

steps.title: Purify via SEC
steps.instruction: Perform size exclusion chromatography to further purify the protein.

substeps.instruction: Load supernatant on HiLoad 16/600 Superdex 200 pg.
Elute in 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4 and collect fractions.

steps.title: Purify via Anion Exchange
steps.instruction: Perform anion exchange chromatography to achieve high purity.

substeps.instruction: Pool α-syn-enriched SEC fractions (monitored by SDS-PAGE).
Run on HiPrep Q HP 16/10 or DEAE in 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4 + 1 mM EDTA.
Elute with a linear NaCl gradient from 25 mM to 1 M NaCl and collect fractions.

steps.title: Final Polishing and Storage
steps.instruction: Finalize protein purity, remove endotoxins, and store monomeric α-syn.

substeps.instruction: Analyze fractions by SDS-PAGE (Coomassie) and pool those with α-syn (target purity ≈ 95%).
Dialyze pooled fractions against PBS (pH 7.4).
Remove endotoxin using Pierce high-capacity endotoxin removal resin per manufacturer’s instructions (aim for ≤0.018 EU/µg protein, verified by LAL or equivalent assay).
Determine protein concentration, aliquot, and store at −80°C.

steps.title: Induce Fibril Formation
steps.instruction: Incubate monomeric α-syn under agitation to form preformed fibrils (PFFs).

substeps.instruction: Prepare monomeric α-syn solution at 5 mg/mL and filter through a 0.22 µm filter into sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes (e.g., 500 µL).
Incubate at 37°C with continuous agitation at 1,000 rpm in a Thermomixer for 7 days under sterile conditions.

steps.title: Harvest and Quantify Fibrils
steps.instruction: Collect fibrils and determine their concentration via dissociation.

substeps.instruction: Pellet fibrils by centrifugation at 13,000 × g for 10 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 250 µL DPBS.
Take a 5 µL aliquot of fibril suspension and incubate with 5 µL of 8 M guanidine-HCl at 22°C for 1 h to dissociate fibrils into monomers.
Measure A₂₈₀ on a Nanodrop/spectrophotometer.

Calculate molar concentration using Molarity (M) = A₂₈₀ / 7450 (where ε₂₈₀ = 7450 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹), then convert to mg/mL using the molecular weight for mouse α-syn (Mass concentration g/L = M × MW), adjusting for the guanidine-HCl dilution.

steps.title: Store and Prepare Fibrils
steps.instruction: Store fibrils and sonicate them prior to use.

substeps.instruction: Store fibrils as 25 µL aliquots at 5 mg/mL at −80°C.
Thaw a 25 µL aliquot on ice and transfer to an ethanol-sterilized sonication tube (e.g., Active Motif #53071).
Sonicate in a cup-horn sonicator (Qsonica q700) at 30% amplitude (~100 W/s) using a cycle of 3 s ON / 2 s OFF for a total 'on' time of 15 min.
Maintain water bath temperature between 5–15°C using ice or a chilled circulating bath.
Keep sonicated samples at room temperature and use promptly.
